metaTitle: Custom Recycled Badge Reels | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom recycled badge reels in bulk for your team. Eco-friendly ID badge holders at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Recycled badge reels let your team display ID cards while supporting sustainability. Made from post-consumer materials, these reels offer the same retractable function as standard options but with a lower environmental impact. They work well for corporate offices, healthcare facilities, and trade shows where eco-conscious branding matters. Choose full-color imprinting on the reel face for logos or messaging that align with your green initiatives.
heroAltText: Custom recycled badge reels with retractable cord and full-color imprint, eco-friendly ID holders
